name: Ascot
_about: Built by tools/course/build_ascot_layout.py from courses/ascot-trace.json. Do not edit by hand; edit the trace or the assembly and re-run.
axes: World plan: origin = winning post on the inside rail; x = east, z = south, y = up (right-handed, as glTF). Running is clockwise (right-handed): on the home straight horses run towards -x; inside rail on their right (-z), stands on their left (+z).

track.note: The turf as rings in world x, z: the first is the outline, the rest are holes (the infield). Built from the inside rail out to trackWidth, plus the chute and the straight mile.

rails.note: Running rail lines, each a polyline in world x, z, 0.4 m outside the turf's edges (inside and outer rails), open at the straight-mile stalls and the chute's start.

winningPost.line: across the track along x = 0, from the inside rail (z 0) to the outer rail (z 30)

insideRail.note: Closed loop in running order from the post; distance to go at sample k = length - k*spacing.

straightMile.insideRail: z = 0 (far side), from x 1609.3 to the post

grandstand.placement: The .glb is built in world axes with its origin at the clock tower on the front line: place it at (0, 0, frontLine), no turn. Built by tools/blender/build_stand_modules.py.
